hub.poker.title: Poker
hub.poker.desc: Texas Hold'em for 2 to 10 players. Chips come from your points: what one wins, the others lose.
hub.poker.off: Your teacher has turned poker off for this class.
hub.poker.consent: First visit: you will read the rules and accept.
hub.bit.title: Bit by Bit
hub.bit.desc: Convert binary and decimal before the rows reach the top. The faster, the more points.
hub.rules.title: Rules in 20 seconds
hub.rules.1: In poker you play with real score points: you can win and lose. There is a daily loss limit.
hub.rules.2: You only play against classmates from your class, and the teacher can watch the tables.
hub.rules.3: In Bit by Bit you earn 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 points a day.
hub.rules.4: Play calmly: this is an extra activity, your grade does not depend on it.

poker.title: Poker
poker.balance_help: Chips come from your points. What you win, others lose (and the other way round).
poker.disabled: Poker is turned off for your class.
poker.no_tables: No tables yet. Create the first one!
poker.consent_text: In poker you win and lose REAL points from your score. Read carefully.
poker.consent_1: What one player wins, the others lose: points move from some players to others.
poker.consent_2: You can only risk part of your balance, and there is a daily loss limit.
poker.consent_3: Losing points lowers your place on the leaderboard.
poker.consent_4: You can leave the table whenever you want. The teacher can see everything and turn poker off.
poker.consent_accept: I understand and want to play
poker.pick_seat: Pick an empty seat to join the table.
poker.buy_in_help: Choose how many points you bring: from {min} to {max} (you have {bal}).
poker.no_balance: Not enough balance to sit down (minimum 10).
poker.leave_confirm: You will leave the table and lose the current hand. Continue?
bit.title: Bit by Bit
bit.intro_title: Convert before they reach the top
bit.intro_text: Rows rise from the bottom of the grid. Each column is the weight of a bit. Get the conversion right to clear the oldest row.
bit.how_bd: Bits shown: type the decimal number and press OK.
bit.how_db: Number shown: switch the right bits on and press OK.
bit.how_top: If a row reaches the top, the game is over. Each level rises faster and uses more bits.
bit.how_keys: Keyboard: arrows pick a bit, Space toggles, digits + Enter answer, P pauses.
bit.intro_note: Every 100 game points are worth 1 score point, up to 50 a day.
bit.practice: Practice mode: the server is not available, so this game earns no points.
bit.save_failed: The game could not be saved.
bit.row_bd: Row with bits {bits}: type the decimal
bit.row_db: Row with number {bits}: switch the bits
poker.you_are_away: You are away (out of the hands). Come back whenever you like.
